hero.title: Yabelana ngenkcubeko yakho. Funda kwezinye zonke.
hero.lede: Bhala ngolwimi lwakho. Funda ibali lakhe nawuphi na ngolwakho.
how.title: Ukusuka kwilizwi lakho ukuya ehlabathini, ngemiqathango yakho
how.s1: Bhala, rekhoda okanye ufote into yenkcubeko yakho, ngolwimi lwakho.
how.s2: Yongeza ukuba phi, nini nendlela owazi ngayo. Imithombo yenza ibali lithembeke.
how.s3: Khetha ukuba ngubani olibonayo. Abafundi balifunda ngolwimi lwabo; elakho lokuqala liyahlala.
cultures.title: Ilizwe ngalinye lineenkcubeko ezininzi
cultures.lede: Ikhadi ngalinye lingumnyango. Vula elinye ubalise oko ukwaziyo.
live.empty: Akukabikho bali likawonke-wonke. Yiba ngowokuqala ukwabelana.
langs.title: Bhala ngolwakho. Funda nangaluphi na.
langs.lede: Iilwimi ezinechaphaza zinejongano eguqulelwe ngomatshini. Izithethi zinokunceda ukulungisa.
collections.title: Izinto zaseKasai
collections.lede: Iirekhodi zokubhekisa zeemyuziyam, zahlukile kumabali oluntu.
rights.title: Amalungelo akho
rights.c1: Akukho nto iba yeyawonke-wonke ude uyivume.
rights.c2: Rhoxisa ibali nangaliphi na ixesha. Iikopi esele zikhutshelwe azinakubuyiswa.
rights.c3: Amazwi akho agcinwa njengoko uwabhalile. Iinguqulelo ziyaphawulwa.
machine.notice: Olu lwimi luguqulelwe ngomatshini kwaye alukahlolwa sisithethi.
